Recommended High-Signal Videos to Watch:
1. [Gita Gopinath (IMF) on Raj Shamani]: How Money Is Created, Central Banks & Inflation (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dNIef2fGLQY)
   - Macro deep dive into fractional reserve banking, money supply, de-dollarization, and currency debasement.
2. [Paul Graham & Amjad Masad (YC)]: How To Build The Future (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q78dJ0vkWe8)
   - Autonomous AI software engineering, commoditization of syntax, where startup moats actually lie.
3. [Zerodha Back Office Ep 5]: Inside Zerodha’s Tech Team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4OqXCbcv5BA)
   - 35 engineers, zero PMs, no Agile overhead, self-hosted open source powering 15%+ of NSE retail volume.
4. [Think School]: 50-Min Bond Masterclass (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjxaqZmvVPA)
   - Corporate bonds, G-Secs, and debt yields for retail investors; locking in 9-10%+ before rate cuts.
5. [Ankur Warikoo]: 1 Lakh Gold Selling Reality (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7ddps0EfIgg)
   - Jewellery math breakdown: 3% GST + 15-25% making charges + resale deductions = ~₹75k recovery.
6. [Day Trader Telugu]: Market Rally vs Portfolio Crash (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wuJ1ARZ5bEQ)
   - FII short-covering in large caps vs mid/small-cap bleed; Angel One taking 15% NSE market share over Zerodha.
7. [Think School]: Real Estate Psychology (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7R747kVWvZY)
   - Hidden registration, stamp duty, maintenance friction vs true index fund compounding.
8. [Zerodha Coin]: Micro-Savings from ₹10 (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HvKjxUSxqx0)
   - Daily automated micro-SIPs for college students & freshers.

Study & Content Focus:
- Comprehensive breakdown: What every salaried individual in India must do after landing their first job (salary slip, EPF/EPS/EDLI, emergency fund, health/term insurance, tax regime, first SIP).

Latest High-Signal Updates (Nov 12-13, 2026):
- Macro: India Oct CPI jumped to 6.09% (2-year high, breaching RBI 6% ceiling). Shuts door on rate cuts, home loan EMIs set to rise.
- Gold & SGB: SGB 2018-19 Series-III reached 8-year final maturity today (Nov 13). ₹3,183/g -> ₹13,700+/g (4.3x gain, 100% tax-free under Sec 47).
- Wedding Gold Math: Quoted 24K vs 22K rate formula, gross-weight making charge inflation (8-25%), 3% GST, and BIS HUID verification.
- EPF vs Home Loan: EPFO Para 68BB allows up to 90% withdrawal for housing, but withdrawing 8.25% sovereign tax-free compounding pool costs ₹85L+ by retirement.
- AMFI Data: 5.9M SIPs stopped in Oct (116% stoppage ratio) as Nifty TRI fell -13.3% YoY. Small-cap inflows fell 29%, large-cap rose 20%.
- Tech & Business: Zupee shuts down / lays off 100% staff due to 28% GST. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid probe & B AI debt scrutiny (forfeits M equity; Colette Kress interim CEO).
- Long-Form Creator: Kent Yoshimura on Raj Shamani (FO587) on building M D2C/quick-commerce brand; Day Trader Telugu on gold drop & Nifty support.

Latest High-Signal Updates (Nov 14-16, 2026):
- Household Debt Crisis: Indian household debt crossed 45.5% of GDP; young earners spending 50-60% of take-home on unsecured EMIs (credit cards, BNPL, gadgets). Golden rule: total EMIs must stay below 35-40%.
- Health Insurance Rejections & The Ombudsman: Free statutory Insurance Ombudsman gives binding awards up to ₹30 Lakhs on insurers within 30 days without court/lawyer fees.
- Offer Letter / CTC Illusion: Why an ₹8 Lakh in-hand offer beats an inflated ₹12 Lakh CTC stuffed with unvested ESOP cliffs and clawback joining bonuses.
- Real Return on FDs: With CPI at 6.09%, a 6.35-7.5% bank FD yields only ~4.4-5.2% post-tax at 30% slab—negative real return.
- Step-Up SIP Compounding: A 10% annual step-up on a ₹10,000 monthly SIP triples terminal 15-year wealth (₹1.45 Cr vs ₹68 Lakhs flat at 12%).
- The Credit Card Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Trap: Paying MAD revokes 45-day interest-free grace period, triggering retroactive 42% APR from date of swipe.
- Regulatory & Gig Economy: Govt creates joint welfare board with Swiggy, Zepto, Zomato mandating health/accident social security via aggregator fee cess.
- Tech & Founders: Nvidia board approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas to succeed Jensen Huang; Think School deconstructs Anthropic IPO compute debt and valuation multiples.

Latest High-Signal Updates (Nov 17-23, 2026):
- EPFO Overhaul: 90% emergency withdrawal cleared in 3 days; new Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) for pensioners to withdraw steady monthly income without liquidating corpus.
- Cyber Fraud Legal Precedents: Madras High Court rules RBI zero-liability circular applies retrospectively; Telangana Consumer Court penalizes SBI (UPI PIN entry does not prove customer consent without telemetry proof).
- Gratuity Before 5 Years: High Court confirms 240-day rule (Section 2A)—employees with 4 years and 240 days qualify for 100% statutory gratuity.
- Tax Notices at Old Addresses: ITAT rules notices sent to obsolete addresses void the assessment under Section 282; assessing officers must verify active PAN portal address.
- Margin Trading Facility (MTF) Trap: SEBI raises alarm over ₹1.5 Lakh Crore retail margin debt (18% interest, 4x leverage) leading to wipeouts.
- SGB Tax-Free Gains: SGB 2020-21 Series II premature redemption at ₹7,698/g vs ₹2,615 (194% tax-free under Sec 47).
- Four Free Credit Reports: RBI mandates 1 free full report annually from each of the 4 bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF)—quarterly free audits.
- Macro: Goldman Sachs forecasts 75 bps RBI repo rate hikes in 2027 following 6.09% CPI print.
- Top Creator Content: Steve Eisman on Diary of a CEO (leverage & crash traps); Ankur Warikoo on health insurance dark side; Think School on Cybertruck and GTA VI economics.

Today's Updates (Nov 24, 2026):
- RBI Draft Mandate: Single-click universal 'Stop Switch' on banking apps to immediately freeze accounts during digital fraud/scams, plus 'trusted-person' secondary approval for large transfers.
- EPFO UPI Integration: Testing real-time PF advance withdrawals via UPI by Dec-end. Caution: instant convenience shouldn't drain 8.25% tax-free retirement compounding.
- Mutual Fund Audit: 5-point test before pausing an underperforming SIP during market dips (rolling returns vs index, quartile ranking, manager stability, expense ratio creep, AUM bloat).
- Foreign Asset Tax Relief (FAST-DS): Income Tax dept clarifies Indian tech workers can disclose multiple foreign holdings/RSUs in one filing for a single ₹1 Lakh fee, avoiding Black Money Act 90% penalty.
- Market: Nvidia surges 31% on Jensen Huang's return, sparking broad tech rally after record volatility.
